triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '2. `@cute.struct class` cannot be passed as `@cute.kernel` argument' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 2. `@cute.struct class` cannot be passed as `@cute.kernel` argument

problem.statement: sm_120 cute 4.4.2 TMA + warp-spec implementation pitfalls -- 2. `@cute.struct class` cannot be passed as `@cute.kernel` argument

payload.attempted: Even with `SharedStorage: cutlass.Constexpr` annotation, cute 4.4.2 still tries to lower the struct class into a dynamic SSA value when it appears in the @cute.kernel signature.
payload.lesson: 2. `@cute.struct class` cannot be passed as `@cute.kernel` argument

established_fact.mechanism: 2. `@cute.struct class` cannot be passed as `@cute.kernel` argument

implementation.snippet:
```
DSLRuntimeError: failed to generate argument #N (SharedStorage)
  for JIT function 'kernel_...'.
  Argument SharedStorage: The DSL attempted to convert it into Dynamic Expression
  (aka MLIR values) but failed.
  Call-site argument value: <cutlass.cute.core.struct object at 0x...>
```
